memory_candidates: @[reducible] on a TemporalOrder.of wrapper is load-bearing for rw motive typing: a plain noncomputable def leaves (UT phi T).carrier unreduced and every rw over the carrier fails with an application type mismatch.
lake-build-guard.sh takes the full lake subcommand after --, i.e. `-- build TARGET`; a malformed `-- TARGET` prints 'unknown command' but still exits 0, so the exit code alone is not a build signal.
